widgets.widgetName: Name(s) as shown on your California tax return
California Secretary of State (S O S) file number (12 digits)
Part II, Line 1. Credit amount. This credit amount is limited to $10,000
Line 2. Pass-through credit from Schedule K-1 (100S, 541, 565, or 568)
Line 3. Credit carryover from prior year(s)
Line 4. Total available credit. Add line 1 through line 3
Line 5a. Credit claimed. Enter the amount of the credit claimed on the current year tax return. (Do not include any assigned credit claimed on form FTB 3544, Part B.)
Line 5b. Total credit assigned. Enter the total amount from form FTB 3544, Part A, column (g). If you are not a corporation, enter 0
Line 5c. Credit amount to be elected as refundable in future years. See instructions
Line 6. Credit carryover available for future years. Add lines 5a, 5b, and 5c, subtract the result from line 4
Part I, Line A. Business name as it appears on the license issued by the California Department of Cannabis Control (D C C)
